name: ESO 203-IG001 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 203-IG001, a luminous infrared galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso203ig001-hubble
story: Hubble surveyed this galaxy as one of the brightest infrared emitters nearby, a class made mostly of interacting or merging disk galaxies busy forming stars.

claims.text: ESO 203-IG001 is a luminous infrared galaxy in the GOALS sample
ESO 203-IG001 is a target of the ACS survey of a complete sample of luminous infrared galaxies
Targets of program 10592 are luminous infrared galaxies, primarily interacting or merging disk galaxies with enhanced star formation and AGN activity
